title: 6.0 / Resources
slide_intent: Separate reference resources from creative rules so contributors can find supporting information quickly.
strategic_value: A clearly marked resource section can reduce inconsistent local lookup practices for Spectrum materials.
demonstration: A cyan 6.0 sits above the dark blue Resources heading on a pale gray gradient. The otherwise open divider marks the start of social and store-location references.
practical_value: Locate account and store-information resources when assembling customer contact details.

content_islands.name: Section heading
content_islands.spec: Place the cyan number above the large dark blue title at upper left, leaving the lower page open.
